_comment: QA deck for Edge TTS narration in the web viewer and VS Code preview. It covers per-slide Listen, live narrated deck playback, pronunciation replacements, editable narration text, and fullscreen rrweb timed narration cues.

scenes.title: Edge TTS narration
scenes.subtitle: Listen per slide, then play the deck live
scenes.narration: This opening slide should speak when you press Listen. Slidey uses Edge TTS for quick review.

scenes.body: Narration can be edited in the deck source or the scene editor, then previewed without rendering an MP4.
scenes.lede: Use this slide to check clean text edits, stop behavior, and replay from the current slide.
scenes.narration: This slide checks the edit loop. Change this sentence, press Listen again, and confirm Edge TTS speaks the latest text without an MP4 render.

scenes.title: Pronunciation checks
scenes.caption: The visible text stays unchanged; only spoken text is respelled.
scenes.narration: This slide checks pronunciations. Slidey, rrweb, SDLC, and Kitsoki should use the deck pronunciation table, while the written text remains unchanged.

narration.text: The rrweb recording starts as a live DOM replay inside the deck.
Chapter cues can trigger narration as the captured story view appears.
The panel opens while live narration stays synchronized to the rrweb player.
The composer appears near the end of the replay, then the live deck can advance.

scenes.narration: The final slide confirms live narrated deck playback advances after normal slides and the fullscreen rrweb replay.
